findings.claim: Bodhan: printed EN+22 langs x 13 scripts; handwriting EN + 12 Indian langs; internal IndicOCR-Printed 86.2% word accuracy; 15M+ docs; Rs0.20/image hosted API
findings.numbers: 86.2%; 22 langs x 13 scripts; 12 langs HW; Rs0.20/image

findings.claim: Sarvam Vision API cost Rs0.5/page, ~$32 for 5,344 test pages; 67% price cut Jun 2026; 10 pages/job, 200 MB/file caps force pre-splitting
Bodhan cost Rs0.20/image = ~Rs245 (~$3) for 1227-page probe; cheapest API; Mistral OCR 3 $2/1000 pages ($1 batch, $3 annotated) ~3-6x cheaper than Sarvam
Sarvam Vision 2.1: SOTA olmOCR-Bench 87.3 and Indic OCR Bench 87.39; CPT on sovereign 3B -> SFT -> RLVR; adds Indic handwritten recognition, form KV, multi-page tables; 3B state-space VLM
Sarvam admits earlier version struggled with complex docs/hallucination/cost; ranked 2nd to PaddleOCR on structure-preservation test: vendor bench != real-world utility
Indic OCR Bench per-language word accuracy for Sarvam: Santali 53.91, Kashmiri 54.82, Manipuri 85.12, Odia 80.01 (weak cells); Maithili 96.70, Konkani 97.41, Nepali 97.00, Marathi 95.06; 6,909 blocks
Bodhan beats Sarvam on Santali (68.30 vs 53.91); Gemini beats Sarvam on Odia (81.01 vs 80.01): specialist beats generalist on sat
Bodhan explicitly tested on Kashmiri, Santali, Manipuri (Meetei Mayek); 0.8B holds its own vs 4-5x larger; rival targets our 3 hardest cells and is the bar to beat

Bodhan IndicOCR: layout detection (PP-DocLayoutV3/RT-DETR) then block-level OCR with Qwen3.5-0.8B; ~1.8GB; reading-order markdown + per-block JSON; licence CC-BY-SA-4.0 per HF card (note: ledger also says 'commercial-friendly')
Sarvam Vision v1 Indic OCR Bench: Hindi 95.91, Bengali 92.61, Tamil 93.42, Telugu 87.70; beats Gemini 3 Pro, GCV, Opus 4.5, Surya, Gemma3-27B, GPT 5.2; strongest closed rival on hi/bn/ta/te
Surya 2: 650M VLM, olmOCR-bench 83.3 best <3B; 91-lang internal 87.2; Bengali 82.7, Hindi 82.2, Persian 82.3, Arabic 72.7; 5.35 pg/s RTX 5090; CPU/Apple via llama.cpp; Surya OldScan 42.8
olmOCR-Bench Old Scans sub-scores: Chandra 1 = 50.4, Surya 2 = 42.8, LightOnOCR-2 = 84.7 (English); contrasts with OldScan 55.3 weak cell (the Indic+degraded double-bind)
Chandra OCR 2: 4B qwen3_5, olmOCR-bench 85.8, multilingual 77.8% (+12% vs Chandra 1), 90+ langs, OpenRAIL-M (free <$2M revenue); Chandra 1 9B 83.1 olmOCR-Bench
Devanagari stress-test: on real Hindi scans Qwen3-VL-8B 75.2 beats GPT-5.5 58.5 and olmOCR-7B 40.5; English OCR ranking does not transfer; open weights+Indic data beat closed

Devanagari stress-test: synthetic chrF++ ~99 for 9/10 systems hides catastrophic repetition failures on real scans; median + catastrophic-rate is the faithful summary; mean CER hides it. R4 adopts median dCER + Wilson CI, never mean alone
Distribution-matched byte-level post-corrector works on matched noise but fails cross-engine; synthetic noise must mimic the 11-engine probe distribution, not vendor OCR
Koshur Pixel: 613,078 synthetic Kashmiri (Nastaliq) image-text pairs from KS-PRET-5M via SynthOCR-Gen, word to page granularity, 25+ augmentations; exceeds the 40-60k synthetic recipe from R2
KS-PRET-5M: 5M-word/12M-token Kashmiri corpus, 81.3% Nastaliq/Arabic-block chars; KS-LIT-3M 3.1M words; SynthOCR-Gen generates 600,000-sample word-segmented Kashmiri OCR dataset on HF

QARI-OCR: Qwen2-VL-2B fine-tuned on progressive synthetic Arabic (5k plain -> 50k diacritized 10-font -> 10k layout HTML); v0.2 WER 0.160 CER 0.061 BLEU 0.737; recipe=50k synthetic + LoRA + 8-bit; direct precedent for Kashmiri specialist. Qari 0.4.0 now Qwen3-VL-4B
UTRNet/UTRSet: 92.97% char accuracy in-domain UTRSet-Real but only 54.84% cross-domain; CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial, dies for ship); 20k synth + 11k real lines
Nayana OCR (LoRA on GOT-OCR, purely synthetic, 10 Indic langs): CER 0.227 on real multilingual eval; synthetic-only ~ classical-OCR parity on printed Indic (supports 'synthetic alone caps CER')

EkStep/Tarento: 90,000 synthetic OCR images over 23 Indic langs with explicit Nastaliq fonts (Mehr Nastaliq Web, Alvi, Pak Nastaleeq, Jameel Noori...) = canonical font inventory for synthetic generation

Santali is multi-script in practice (Bengali/Odia/Devanagari/Ol Chiki, 4 scripts); Mozhi-LR real+synthetic for 9 languages confirms specialist > shared model; MMLoSo shows Ol Chiki true-alphabet does not doom shared training if script-aware embeddings
Label-free adaptation (IIIT-H ICVGIP 2025): iterative pseudo-label self-training on printed Indic OCR; proposed for barred languages ks/mni/ur/sat without human labels

IndicSTR12 excludes Sanskrit, Bodo, Dogri, Kashmiri, Konkani, Maithili...; BharatSceneText excludes Urdu+Meitei; Bhashini production OCR covers 8 langs scene-text (as/bn/gu/hi/kn/ml/mni/mr); no production OCR for sat/ks/ur/sd; AI4Bharat OCR site is placeholder

Handwriting corpora: IIIT-HW-Dev 95K Devanagari words, IIIT-HW-Telugu 120K words; ICDAR 2025 IHDR sets (IIIT-Indic-HW-UC, IHWWR-1.0, PLHWTR-1.0, IHTR-2022/23) free for academic use; IHDR comp closed 2025-05-10, winner 2025-05-15
SemiHastakshar (IIIT-H, WACV 2026): semi-supervised fine-tuned PARSeq for Indic handwriting generalising across scripts; proposed recipe for scarce-label handwritten cells

PLATTER + CHIPS: first page-level Indic handwritten OCR dataset (CC-BY-4.0); UniLipi (ICDAR 2026, IIIT-H): unified multi-script handwritten manuscript OCR over 13 Indic scripts incl contemporary handwriting
AnciDev (BHASHA 2025): 3,000 lines/500 pages ancient Devanagari handwriting; CER CNN-RNN 48.59, Attention-LSTM 46.3x; Tesseract-5 ~30% CER = classical floor on historical
IndicPhotoOCR (Bhashini-IITJ, MIT) is a SCENE-TEXT toolkit (11 Indic langs + EN, ViT/PARSeq-based), Apr 2026 update adds batch inference/caching/confidence; not handwriting-trained
Scene-text baselines: IIIT-ILST CNN-RNN WRR Hindi 42.9, Telugu 57.2, Malayalam 73.4 (2021 lower bound)
Sarvam Vision 2.1 adds Indic handwriting recognition and Bodhan has HW for 12 langs: handwriting is a named rival axis

Chitrapathak-2: fine-tuned Nanonets-OCR2-3B/Qwen2.5-VL beats LLaVA-from-scratch; Telugu char ANLS 6.69 vs 11.00; 3-6x faster; covers Odia, 10 langs+EN; Parichay 89.8% exact match on 9 govt docs; no extra multimodal pretraining

Recipe evidence: fine-tune OCR-specialised model rather than build from scratch; progressive curriculum (HindiOCR-VLM LoRA on GOT-OCR2.0); olmOCR-2 SFT 1 epoch then GRPO 1 epoch with unit-test rewards; MinerU2.5-Pro gains +2.71 (92.98->95.69) from data engineering alone
dots.ocr: Qwen2.5-VL-72B teacher -> 7B student via structured re-rendering, XDocParse 126 langs; GPU budget is the blocker for scaling distillation
Qwen3-VL OCR expands from 10 to 32 languages; sizes 2B/4B/8B/32B + 30B-A3B + 235B-A22B; Apache-2.0; could replace Qwen2.5-VL-7B as W6 Stage-2 base
PaddleOCR-VL-1.6: 0.9B, 96.33% OmniDocBench v1.6, Apache-2.0, ~2GB VRAM FP16, ~45 pg/min L40S; Real5-OmniDocBench 93.19 (warp 91.25 weakest, scan 94.74)

LightOnOCR-2-1B: olmOCR-Bench 76.4, 9x smaller than Chandra-9B, 3.3x faster than Chandra; MonkeyOCR weights non-commercial; GOT-OCR2.0 580M Apache code but research-only data licence; dots.ocr 1.7B MIT/Apache

Self-host comparison: GOT-OCR2.0 <3GB speed leader printed (8GB laptop); DeepSeek-OCR 16x token compression 200K pages/day A100; Surya 2 llama.cpp laptop path; Marker pattern text-layer first then OCR fallback

Bodhan-style layout->block pipeline and script-router: IndicTrans2 22 langs x 5 scripts as canonical router pattern; ScriptMoE lifts PP-OCRv5 F1 65.71->80.89; IIIT-H multilingual OCR (2016) 13 scripts word-level script ID

OldScan R4 chain arms: A0 none / A1 deskew+Otsu / A2 Sauvola-frozen / A3 DocRes-head pilot (n<=8); 4-page gate; no thinning post-binarization; dot/matra audit (R4 C5) precedes expansion; pilot subset must include >=4 warped pages
findings.numbers: OldScan 55.3; n<=8; >=4 warped; bar median dCER -0.03

findings.claim: R4 verdict: OldScan 55.3 will not move by restoration alone; Stage 2 fine-tune is higher leverage; if A3 pilot misses median dCER -0.03 bar, move to per-script fine-tune (W6 stage 2)

Binarization: no universal winner across DIBCO years (DE-GAN 13, DP-LinkNet 17, 2-StageGAN 18, SauvolaNet 19); DIBCO has no Indic edition so no Latin->Indic transfer; GAN/diffusion repaint risk on dots/nuqta so excluded from CPU ablation; classical Otsu/Sauvola kept

DocRes (MIT, Restormer, SD7K deshadow 33.13 dB) is first A3 arm; DocRes prompts do not always help so freeze prompt on 4-page gate; DocRevive RoBERTa-large UCSM 0.6102 vs Qwen3-0.6B 0.1240, exact match 21.60% vs 0.15% (English)

Dewarp candidates ranked: Hybrid DL+cubic polynomial (CPU, median CER 0.0235 IWILT) cheapest, D2Dewarp (CVPR 2026), DvD coordinate diffusion (GPU only); DocMatcher excluded (template needed); Real-ESRGAN avoided on text (own README); text-aware SR (TextSR, PRISM ms-inference) deferred

PreP-OCR (ACL 2025): ResShift restoration + patch fusion -> Tesseract -> ByT5 correction cuts CER 63.9%-70.3% across 13,831 historical pages; English only, Indic transfer UNKNOWN; Scrambled-text (Bourne): synthetic corruption LM post-corrector CER -55% WER -32% on Hindi

Diffusion restorers (Uni-DocDiff, MMDIR, DocPure, UniT, DocDiff 4.17M params 5 steps) are W6-GPU queue only, not in CPU ablation; Albumentations (unmaintained since Jun 2025 -> AlbumentationsX) is the W6 augmentation composer; PlasmaShadow may erase nuqta

Stage 3 normalisation: IndicNLP normalizer (MIT; ZWJ/ZWNJ, nukta) canonical; Aksharamukha GPL-3.0 (120 scripts) restrictive for closed product, python lib suggested; Stage-3 LLM candidates IndicBERTv2 270M, Gemma4 31B > Sarvam 30B on IndicQuest v2 (69,420 QA, 19 langs)
Bhashini LEAP Hackathon PS-2 winner Team Multilipi, runner-up Soochna Sahayak; BharatGen sovereign Indic AI 15 langs soon 22: competitor set for jury

Win condition: tables + forms + handwriting are the 3 demo axes; Sarvam has all three, Bodhan too; we need at least tables parity; Mistral OCR 3 closed API OCRBench v2 25.2%, composite 79.75 OmniDocBench vs PaddleOCR 92.86 vs dots.ocr 88.41
IIIT-H Multilingual Indian Document Understanding Benchmark: 52,607 docs, 23 langs, 13 domains, 71 classes, 52 tasks, 2.4M+ QA; proposed as W6 eval harness (post-freeze, approval needed)

Harness constants repeated in every record: 18 Indic langs, weak cells Santali/Kashmiri/OldScan/Odia, no paid keys, 200-dpi citizen docs, no training until W6 freeze, offline-capable, WRAP-only for closed weights, Sarvam is benchmark target not pipeline component (D2), zero GPU cost (D1)

Decision language across ledger: W6 Stages 0 restoration / 1 layout / 2 base VLM + QLoRA / 3 normalisation+LLM / 3b post-correction (RLVR); base candidates open: Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-4B/8B, PaddleOCR-VL-1.6, Chandra 2, dots.ocr, LightOnOCR-2, GOT-OCR2, UniLipi; freeze decision waits Phase 6
